name: subagents-poll
title: The subagents tool never blocks
about: A thread starts one subagent that runs until stopped, then asks for the subagents' state twenty times. The tool answers at once each time (the record's MCP calls are twenty and every one took under a second), the thread ends its turn and waits, and Stop ends it all.

steps.text: Check one thing [fake:delegate] mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Check links","prompt":"Look at the links [fake:slow]"} ; poll 20

steps.expect: The thread ends its turn quickly, having polled twenty times

sh.run:
python3 -c 'import json
L=[json.loads(l) for l in open("$work/fake-record.jsonl")]
m=[l["mcp_call"] for l in L if "mcp_call" in l and l["mcp_call"].get("tool","").endswith("subagents")]
ok=len(m)==20 and all(x.get("ms",9999)<1000 for x in m)
print("ok" if ok else ("bad %d %s" % (len(m),max([x.get("ms",0) for x in m] or [0]))))'

steps.expect: Twenty calls to the subagents tool, each answered in under a second
The thread waits on the subagent

steps.name: waiting
steps.expect: Waiting on the subagent after the polls
Stop ends the thread and its subagent
